model: RSI Gold Scalper V2 / trend-session-v2 / full_tp1

offline_verification.method: Restricted JavaScript translation of actual MQL numeric functions with explicit API shims, compared with actual PHP 8.5.11 strategy outputs; not native MQL execution.

limits: This release has not been run in native MT5 Strategy Tester, on demo, or against a live broker. Compilation and translated-source parity do not establish native execution correctness or profitability.
Historical cases are existing research fixtures, not unseen profitability validation. Different broker feeds, tick grids, fees, spread and fills can produce different trades and returns.
The UTC+3 preset is unverified. Initialization intentionally requires operator confirmation of historical broker UTC offsets/DST. Live-account operation is blocked.
Sizing estimates stop risk in account currency, including configured deviation/commission reserves. Actual gaps, slippage, swaps and costs can exceed that estimate.
After a restart, existing server stops/targets remain; exact original levels cannot be reconstructed if manually altered while the EA was stopped.
Broker holiday/early-close handling, actual event ordering and trade responses require broker-history and demo testing. No news filter, daily loss cap or fixed holding-time exit is implemented.
Compiled CoreSelfTest numeric constants were independently compared with actual PHP (20 golden values, zero differences); its native runtime assertions have not been executed.
